dedupe_keys.name: historical data on electricity production and consumption in quebec

description: Historical data on electricity production and consumption in Quebec is a dataset listed in Open Government portal of Canada, an open data portal, published or maintained by Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Hydro‑Québec data set on electricity production and distribution in Quebec. Updated annually, the data is sent to the Régie de l'Énergie du Québec after being audited. Each history covers every hour of every day of a year and reflects the significant volume of electricity that passes through the province's lines. Coverage: Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. The portal files it under the publisher Government and Municipalities of Québec | Gouvernement et municipalités du Québec. Its tags are Quebec data, Données du Québec. It offers 4 resource(s) in HTML, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-05-27 as the last update. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is Creative Commons 4.0 Attribution (CC-BY) licence – Quebec. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support electricity network, generation and charging-infrastructure studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-am-canada-portal.
